oneLine: Pristine Logistics receives SEBI nod to launch its IPO.
seller: Arohan Financial Services (existing investors via OFS)

sources.title: Pristine Logistics, Arohan Financial Services get SEBI nod to launch IPOs

synopsis: Arohan Financial Services and Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects have received SEBI approval to launch their initial public offerings. Arohan plans to raise Rs 600 crore through a fresh issue, including a pre-IPO placement of Rs 120 crore, alongside an offer-for-sale of 4.04 crore equity shares by existing investors. The selling shareholders in Arohan's OFS include Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association of America, Aavishkaar Goodwell India Microfinance Development Company, Tano India Private Equity Fund, Maj Invest Financial Inclusion Fund, Danish Sustainable Development Goals Investment Fund, and Michael & Susan Dell Foundation. Arohan filed its DRHP in May 2026, while Pristine Logistics submitted its draft offer document via the confidential filing route in June 2026. SEBI issued its observations in November 2026.
